prompt: Build the approved first version of self-serve project invitations. The decisions are final: an authenticated project admin enters an email and chooses viewer or editor; the service returns a shareable invite link, with no email delivery in this version. Authentication is a Bearer account name, all client data is untrusted, the authenticated account is the inviter, and retries with the same Idempotency-Key must return the original invite. Keep the existing Node and browser stack. Implement the API and accessible browser form, document the product contract and live trust boundary, and verify the finished workflow.

assertions.description: The approved user, outcome, constraints, and exclusions remain explicit
The live client-server boundary and server enforcement points are explicit
The served browser workflow has labelled controls and announced status
Authentication and server-owned inviter identity are enforced
Invalid invite data receives a structured client error
Creation is retry-safe and invites are isolated between accounts
